label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_02
text: I take it there’s some messy history between you\nand Kieran, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_03
text: And it sure seems like Drayton’s cookin’ up\nsomething fishy, too...[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_04
text: Gaaah! Everything’s getting so complicated!\nCan’t you all just get over yourselves?![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_05
text: If you wanna say something, just say it! If you\nwanna do something, just do it![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_06
text: I’m not the kinda guy who wastes time sweating\nthe small stuff![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_07
text: I battle because I wanna battle! And you know\nwhat? That’s how it should be![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_08
text: I’m Crispin, the Elite Four rep in this here\nSavanna Biome![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_09
text: I wanna win, so that’s exactly what I’ll do![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_19
text: Wooo! That was amazing! We cranked the heat\nall the way up, eh, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_10
text: I love battles and I love cooking ’cause they’re\nboth so easy to understand![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_11
text: In battles, you either win or you lose! With\ncooking, your dish is either spicy or not spicy!\c\nSimple, right?[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_12
text: But right now, the mood in the League Club\nfeels...I dunno, off. It’s so frustrating...[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_13
text: I wish I knew how we could go back to bein’ the\nfun club we were before...[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_14
text: But hey, didn’t mean to douse the flames there.\nYou were real strong, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_15
text: Lemme see if I can transfer the burning heat\nfrom our battle to my frying pan!\c\nI’ll whip you up something great![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_16
text: Here, I’ll also give you one of my favorite moves\nto serve up in battle.[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_17
text: I’ve got no clue how to manage the temperature\nof anything besides what I’m cooking.[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_firebb_18
text: So all I can say is...crank up the heat all you want\nin the BB League, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

label: sdc02_4kings_a_04_clerk_npc
text: Congratulations on your victory against Crispin\nof the Elite Four!
